highlights: Check for Updates… in the Memory Trail app menu.
Automatic periodic update checks without embedding GitHub credentials.
A polished What’s New changelog on first launch of each new version.

changelog.title: Faster Launch
items: The animated loading screen now completes in 2 seconds.
Startup work continues during the splash so Memory Trail is ready when the window appears.

changelog.title: Built-in Updates
items: Check manually from Memory Trail → Check for Updates….
Memory Trail also checks periodically for newer releases.
Download Update opens the latest DMG release.

changelog.title: What’s New
items: Each new version can present a polished first-launch changelog.
Reopen it anytime from the Memory Trail app menu.

changelog.title: Privacy Preserved
items: Update checks request version metadata only.
Timeline data, clipboard history, files, conversations, and searches remain local.
